mapper.insert: INSERT INTO contact (b_idx, u_idx, ct_start_date, ct_duration, ct_headcount, ct_content, ct_status) VALUES ( #{brnIdx}, #{userIdx}, #{cntStartDate}, #{cntDuration}, #{cntHeadcount}, #{cntContent}, #{cntStatus} )
mapper.select: SELECT c.ct_idx, c.b_idx, c.u_idx, c.ct_start_date, c.ct_duration, c.ct_headcount, c.ct_content, c.ct_status, c.ct_created_at, b.b_name, IFNULL(u.u_name, '알 수 없음') AS u_name FROM contact c LEFT JOIN branch b ON c.b_idx = b.b_idx LEFT JOIN user u ON c.u_idx = u.u_idx ORDER BY c.ct_created_at DESC

SELECT c.ct_idx, c.b_idx, c.u_idx, c.ct_start_date, c.ct_duration, c.ct_headcount, c.ct_content, c.ct_status, c.ct_created_at, b.b_name, IFNULL(u.u_name, '알 수 없음') AS u_name FROM contact c LEFT JOIN branch b ON c.b_idx = b.b_idx LEFT JOIN user u ON c.u_idx = u.u_idx WHERE c.b_idx = #{brnIdx} ORDER BY c.ct_created_at DESC

SELECT c.ct_idx, c.b_idx, c.u_idx, c.ct_start_date, c.ct_duration, c.ct_headcount, c.ct_content, c.ct_status, c.ct_created_at, b.b_name, IFNULL(u.u_name, '알 수 없음') AS u_name FROM contact c LEFT JOIN branch b ON c.b_idx = b.b_idx LEFT JOIN user u ON c.u_idx = u.u_idx WHERE c.ct_idx = #{cntIdx}
